evidence: nums2[i] = nums1[i] - nums1[j], for an index j != i
analysis: Always feasible. If all inputs are even, keep them. Otherwise keep each odd input, select one odd value, and subtract it from each even value. The selected odd is always at a different index from the even one, and each difference is odd. A one-element array already qualifies. This proof needs no enumeration of pairwise differences.
